decision: Run autonomous batch tuning and bounded training research without per-parameter user confirmation.

must_report_when: two consecutive batches fail to beat or complement D-I
a candidate improves success through wrap, non-tip contact, floor contact, crush, or unsafe force/current proxy
a source-of-truth or mainline boundary would change

batch_plan.purpose: 50 to 150 trial validation for best smoke candidates
bounded residual or quality/gain head training after the target signal is proven

pid_ai_decision.controller_surface_if_unlocked: active thumb/finger pair bounded PD/PID wrapper with anti-windup, saturation, and rate limits

success_policy: Promote only a bounded Stage3.12 candidate with matched metrics, metadata, report, and visual evidence.
failure_policy: Keep Stage3.10E and D-I, stop local tuning, and move to contact geometry, morphology labels, or bounded residual data improvement.
